QuestInfo.name: [Celestial] The Fire Thief
QuestInfo.0:
#e<The Fire Thief>#n

The time has come for the fireworks show, the highlight of the Celestial Festival, but a foul plot is afoot. It seems the Desert Giant has set about stealing the fireworks which were carefully crafted from fire flowers gathered near the mountains of Perion.

The show must go on. #bDefeat the Desert Giant#k, retrieve the fireworks, and launch them into the night!

#b#e[Event Period]#k#n
